blockingFindings.title: R5 does not require both generated skill and preset refresh evidence
blockingFindings.issue: The R5 test accepts upgrade evidence when `changed` contains either `senti.flow` or an AGENTS/preset-related artifact because the regex uses alternation. It also only verifies the generated `senti.flow` skill file afterward. R5 requires generated skill and preset artifacts to be refreshed after source template changes using `senti upgrade`, so this can pass without proving the preset artifact was refreshed.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Make the R5 test require separate evidence for the generated skill refresh and the generated preset/AGENTS artifact refresh, and verify the relevant generated preset artifact content or path explicitly.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement-to-test artifact marks R5 as covered, but the executable test leaves one half of the must requirement untested.
